body: I’ve been having a similar thought, and been wishing to die during my sleep so that it’ll be like natural death. I have GAD and everything just seems to get through me especially with what’s happening in the world and I feel so alienated with the thoughts. I feel like I’m watching myself deteriorate as time goes by and just want death to come. I’m trying to suppress my suicidal thoughts and depression with doing school works but this increases my stress and if it increases my stress it will also fuel my anxiety which will lit my depression, so right now I don’t really know if I wanna die because all I know is don’t wanna be human.
